messages:
Tess H: Starter-kit CI flake: structured function-call fails after transient 401. Validator says unexpected token at end of JSON.
Ravi V: Can you paste the raw payload?
Tess H: logged body looks like "{\"tool\":\"eval\",\"input\":\"x\\n\"}" — looks double-quoted with escaped newline.
Maya L: Likely cause: json-mode helper appends a newline delimiter, then retry middleware does JSON.stringify on the already-serialized string during retry. Results: quoted-string-with-escaped-newline that strict parser rejects. Also breaks HMAC signing because bytes differ from Py SDK (which signs json+"\n").
Ravi V: Fix plan: in retry wrapper detect typeof body === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(body) and send as-is; compute signature over Buffer.from(payloadToSend) so signing matches Py. Add unit test for 401->200 flow and signature parity.
Tess H: I'll add an e2e in sample-app that stubs auth to 401 once then 200 and asserts Buffer equality of received body to expected bytes (including newline).
Maya L: Also add a short migration note: "If using json-mode, middleware/retry logic must not re-serialize the body; preserve raw bytes for signing and schema parity across SDKs."
ci-bot: PR #6120 opened by ravi-v: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry; sign canonical bytes"  https://ci.redwood/p/6120
